flawed_step: The universal assertion fails for the middle vertex of a 5-vertex path.
counterexample: Let T be the path v1-v2-v3-v4-v5. It is a tree on n=5 vertices. Vertex v3 has degree 2, but its only neighbors v2 and v4 both have degree 2, so v3 is adjacent to no leaf.
assessment_summary: The path on five vertices satisfies all hypotheses and violates the conclusion.
